title: h3: a STAC Collection for a layer on the H3 grid
description: A STAC Collection for a layer whose native grid is H3: the obis-h3 release as an atlas collection (build week 4), the hex twins of gridded layers, BioTrack. It says which resolutions exist, how a file path is built from a resolution (and a parent cell, a period or other keys), which columns hold the cell id and the metrics, and optionally where the species x hex x count table is (the answer to the h3t service). STAC core is out of scope: only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through.

h3:resolutions.description: the H3 resolutions published, each 0 to 15

h3:cell_column.description: the column holding the cell id; by convention h3

h3:cell_type.description: how the cell id is stored: string (hex, e.g. 872830828ffffff) or uint64

h3:layout.description: how a file path (relative to the collection) is built

template.description: the path of the whole layer at one resolution, e.g. all/res={res}/data_0.parquet

parent_template.description: the path of one parent cell's split at one resolution, e.g. all/res={res}/p={parent}/data_0.parquet

parent_res.description: the resolution of the parent cell a resolution is split by, e.g. {"6": 2, "7": 3}; the parent is coarser (a reader check)

keys.description: the other placeholders of the templates, e.g. eov or taxon

h3:periods.description: the time periods published, when the layer has more than one

values.description: the periods, as they appear in a path (e.g. 1990s, 2000s)

placeholder.description: the template placeholder a period fills, e.g. period

table:columns.description: the columns of the layer's files, the cell column and the metrics (table extension); other column keys pass through

type.description: the column type, e.g. VARCHAR, BIGINT, DOUBLE

h3:species_table.description: the species x hex x count table: which species were recorded in a cell and how often, partitioned so a click or a place reads one file

href_template.description: the path of the table at one resolution, e.g. species/res={res}/class={class}/data_0.parquet

resolutions.description: the resolutions the table is published at

sorted_by.description: the columns the rows are sorted by within a file, so a cell reads one row group

columns.description: the column names of the table

year.description: the year column, when counts are per year

lookup.description: the species lookup: one row per species, with its names and lineage

href.description: the lookup Parquet, relative to the collection

lineage_column.description: the column holding the array of ancestor ids of each species, for a taxon filter

rank_columns.description: the column holding each rank's name, by rank (phylum, class ... species)

name_column.description: the column holding the scientific name
